title: Kalinga War
place: Kalinga (battle presumed at Dhauli), Odisha, India
summary: The Maurya Empire conquered the coastal kingdom of Kalinga in one of the largest and deadliest battles in Indian history.
why: The only major war Ashoka fought after taking the throne.

notes.problem: Place stated as fact; source: 'It is presumed that the battle was fought on Dhauli hills'.
